'''Soleric''' was a [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was in command the [[16th Escort Force]] that was tasked with the protection of commercial starships traveling between the [[Induparan Crown Worlds]] in the [[Ado sector/Legends|Ado sector]].

When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] started to employ [[Rebel privateer|privateer]] to ambush Imperial starships Commodore Soleric struggled to maintain control.
